title: Sone Se Pehle Kya Padhte Hain? 🌙 | Sone Ki Dua | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Raat ho gayi! Ammi ne poocha, sone se pehle kya padhte hain? Zara ko nahi pata tha... Ali ne bataya! 🌙🤲

📖 Sone ki dua:
"Bismika Allahumma amootu wa ahya"
(Ae Allah, tere naam se main sota hoon aur jaagta hoon)
Hudhayfah (RA): Nabi ﷺ jab bistar par jaate to yeh dua padhte the.
— Sahih Bukhari 6324 (Sahih)

Apne bachchon ke saath zaroor dekhein. Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah ko subscribe karein ❤️
